title: Subscription
subtitle: Your plan, the next charge and your invoice data.

current.title: Current plan
current.noSubscription: You do not have a subscription.
current.validUntil: Valid until {date}. There will be no further charges.
current.grace: We could not charge your subscription. The plan holds until {date}; then the account goes back to Free. Nothing is deleted.

choose.title: Choose a plan
choose.availableFrom: Available from {date}. This change can only be made in the last month of the period already paid.
choose.scheduledBlocks: A plan change is already scheduled. Cancel it to choose another plan.

effect.new: Valid as soon as the payment is confirmed.
effect.upgrade: Valid right away. What you did not use of the current plan is refunded.
effect.later: You pay now and the plan starts on {date}, when the current one ends.

tax.title: Invoice data
tax.description: We issue an invoice for every subscription.
tax.payerEmail: E-mail of your Mercado Pago account
tax.payerEmailHint: It must be the e-mail of the account that will pay; otherwise Mercado Pago refuses the payment.
tax.payHint: You pay at Mercado Pago; CriptEnv never sees your card data. The charge repeats every cycle until you cancel.

cancel.title: Cancel the subscription?
cancel.refund: The amount paid is refunded and the account goes back to Free now. This automatic refund works once per account.
cancel.untilEnd: There will be no further charges and the plan holds until {date}. Then the account goes back to Free. Nothing is deleted.
cancel.refundScheduled: The amount paid for the change is refunded. The current plan continues until the end of the period already paid; to keep it after that, subscribe again.
cancel.scheduledNote: The cancellation applies to the scheduled change. The current plan ends when the period already paid is over.
cancel.doneRefunded: Subscription canceled. The amount paid was refunded.
cancel.doneUntil: Subscription canceled. The plan holds until {date}.

errors.conflict: This action is not possible in the current state of the subscription.
errors.invalid: Check the invoice data: a CPF has 11 digits and a CNPJ has 14, digits only.
errors.provider: Mercado Pago did not answer. Nothing was changed; try again in a few minutes.
